  "overall_experience": "This Senior Accountant has generally found LiveAgent to be a reliable and comprehensive tool for managing various communications over their two-plus years of use. They appreciate its ability to centralize interactions and provide useful reporting, which is beneficial for their role. While the platform offers solid functionality and integrates well with their IT environment, they have noted occasional frustrations with the depth of customization for finance-specific tasks and the responsiveness of customer support."
